messages:
Sam (Product): quick sync: drafting the Optimize Toolkit launch plan. i'd like to lock scope and acceptance criteria today so eng/ML can estimate.
Jordan (Eng): ok, curious about phasing. do we do a single launch or beta waves?
Sam (Product): propose waves: wave-0 internal beta (eng only), wave-1 public beta (batch + simple cache), wave-2 quant recommendations, wave-3 eval-alerts + SRE integration. each wave needs gating.
Priya (ML): for quant recs, gating must include automated eval vs baseline prompts, and an uncertainty threshold. if recommendation confidence < 0.8, don't recommend auto-deploy.
Marta (CS): pilots care about safety. suggestion: any recommended quant change must have a "preview" endpoint that returns both outputs and a quality delta summary so customers can eyeball.
Alex (DevEx): SDK impact: we'll add route-level YAML config and per-request flags. sample route config we plan to show in docs:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: generate
    batching: auto
    cache: {enabled: true, ttl: 180}
    quant_policy: conservative
```
Jordan (Eng): tech risks: batching heuristics are straightforward, but shared KV caching across model variants + multi-tenant eviction quotas needs infra work. estimate: 3 sprints infra + 1 sprint runtime.
Sam (Product): acceptance criteria draft for wave-1 (batch+cache):
- end-to-end flow documented + SDK examples
- >=12% median token-cost reduction on our internal demo app w/ <40ms p95 latency regression
- two pilot customers onboarded with migration docs
- rollout config with canary toggle
Priya (ML): wave-2 acceptance (quant recs):
- recommendation engine outputs "profiles" (e.g., fp16, int8, int4) with expected metric deltas
- auto-eval runs per profile across baseline prompt sets and stores results in Evals DB
- one pilot approves automated recommendation and one pilot requires manual review
Marta (CS): wave-3 acceptance (eval-alerts):
- alert can be configured per-route, with dedupe window and severity levels
- alert payload contains failing prompts, baseline vs latest diffs, and suggested remediation bullets
- integration with PagerDuty for Sev1s and a CS ticket template for customer follow-up
Jordan (Eng): ops checklist to gate releases:
- load tests with representative token distribution pass
- fallback behavior validated (route-level disabling of batching/cache)
- rollback tested via config flip and model pinning
- migration script to update existing route configs
infra-bot: created issue OPT-2001: wave-1 infra spikes (assigned to Jordan).
Sam (Product): decide on metrics we will publish externally vs internal only. i think publishable: cost reduction %, latency delta, and stability incidents. not publishable: per-customer token spend.
Alex (DevEx): docs plan: quickstart for beta, migration guide, and a troubleshooting page that explains common regressions (e.g., cache staleness, batch tail spikes).
Priya (ML): we should add a "safety gate" for quant recs: if hallucination rate increases by >2% absolute vs baseline, block rollout. we need a clear definition for hallucination signal.
Marta (CS): customer onboarding: small pilot cohort (3 customers) for wave-1, each with a 2-week shadow period then opt-in. i'll draft a pilot script.
Jordan (Eng): tentative timeline: wave-0 (eng beta) 2 weeks, wave-1 6 weeks, wave-2 10 weeks, wave-3 5 weeks. dependencies may shift.
Sam (Product): action items: Jordan - eng gating checklist + rough sprint tasks; Priya - define baseline prompt sets + hallucination metric; Alex - SDK examples + route YAML; Marta - pilot outreach and script. i'll assemble PRD by Tue.
Marta (CS): pinging OmniRetail and BrightLearn for pilot invites.
Alex (DevEx): i can prototype the YAML docs and a sample app showing cost before/after.
Jordan (Eng): starting spike on cache eviction policies today.
Sam (Product): cool. small ask: try to keep wave-1 API surface minimal. we can add more knobs later. stopping here unless anyone has objections. :white_check_mark:
